FROZEN.json itself (815e08079aef, frozen_at 2026-09-12T00:57:26+08:00) has no artifact event either, and outbox artifact announcements found (pending ingest): {"schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml": [{"file": "astra-lead-formulation.jsonl", "event_id": "lead-form-20260912T005743-00", "path": "schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml", "sha256": "d9cebb9404b2"}, {"file": "astra-lead-formulation.jsonl", "event_id": "lead-form-20260912T005743-03", "path": "artifacts/formulation/schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml", "sha256": "d9cebb9404b2"}], "schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml": [{"file": "a. This violates the manifest's own change_protocol (a canonical change must re-emit an artifact event with the new sha256), so hash-bound reviewers cannot bind the rev29 bytes from the stream; reviews referencing the new hashes exist but are not announcements of the artifact.

Event-stream created_at shadow: 1/5 held paths have non-pin artifact events whose created_at sorts newer than the FROZEN pin event, so resolution-by-created_at over the accepted stream binds stale bytes even though disk is correct. research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml <- leadform-artifact-0095-r4f0 (2026-09-12T00:44:00+08:00, sha 276009f4f63d, supersedes=leadform-artifact-0085-r4f0, future_dated=false). Ordering by ingest order (_received_at) instead resolves to the pin for 2/5 held paths (created_at resolves for 1/5), and the shadowing events self-declare supersession: research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml: leadform-artifact-0095-r4f0. Shadowing events with no _received_at (fallback rule needed): none. Repair path is therefore a read-path rule (rank by _received_at with a defined fallback for events lacking it), not a canonical byte edit.
Declared-evidence resolution (R4) is repaired in the live F2b rev13 bytes (declared == measured); the remaining hard failure is R3 (3 unannounced pin(s), 1 shadowed).

FROZEN revision moved 28 -> 29 (frozen_at 2026-09-12T00:57:26+08:00, manifest 815e08079aef) between the r2 baseline and this probe. Every reviewer verdict bound to the rev28 pins is void; coverage restarts at the rev29 hashes, which are not yet announced by artifact events (HF-05-01).

next_falsifier: A re-probe in which (a) under the read path actually used to resolve 'latest artifact per path' every held path resolves to the FROZEN rev29 pin sha256 (conditions: created_at order has no non-pin event newer than the pin event, or the binding read path ranks by _received_at with a defined fallback for events lacking it, and no future-dated stale event wins); (b) F2b f0_binding.consistency_evidence_sha256 equals the measured sha256 of the path it names, stably across two consecutive probes; (c) all 50 FROZEN pins and FROZEN.json itself stay drift-free, so that no held path is off-pin at a manifest revision that does not carry the new bytes. Condition (b) may be met either by refreshing the declaration to the live path hash or by moving the live evidence to the declared bytes; a declared hash resolving only at a reconstruction outside the declared path does not satisfy it. Any canonical byte move voids this window, not the finding.
